Senior Data Analyst

Fictive Corp is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our growing analytics team.

Responsibilities

  • Own weekly reporting for the operations team
  • Build dashboards in SQL and Python
  • Partner with product on experiment design

Requirements

  • 4+ years in an analytics or data science role
  • Strong SQL and at least one scripting language
  • Experience presenting findings to non-technical stakeholders

Benefits

Health insurance, 401k match, unlimited PTO.
